name: Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited
remarksWeb: Note:   1) The Company has allotted 34,83,24,626 fully paid-up Optionally Convertible Debentures (OCDs) of face value Rs. 100/- each to the lenders of the Company pursuant to the Scheme for Sustainable Structuring of Stressed Assets (S4A Scheme) during the month of December 2017.  2) The total paid up capital of the Company assuming full conversion of OCDs is subject to conversion price on the date of conversion.  3) For the purpose of this shareholding pattern, it is assumed that OCDs will be converted into equity shares based on the conversion price of Rs. 14.76, being the price for issue of equity shares under S4A Scheme as per the pricing guidelines for issuance of equity shares under the RBI circular dated June 08, 2015 on Strategic Debt Restructuring Scheme read with Regulation 70(5) of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosures Requirement) Regulations 2015.   4)  Shareholders under certain groups having multiple folios have been consolidtaed on the basis of the PAN in this Report. On account of  consolidation of PAN, the number of folios have been reduced from 208469  to 203754.
